meta.name: qwen-image-2
meta.description: Generate and edit images with Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0 models via inference.sh CLI. Models: Qwen-Image-2.0 (fast), Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro (professional text rendering). Capabilities: text-to-image, multi-image editing, complex text rendering. Triggers: qwen image, qwen-image, alibaba image, dashscope image, qwen image 2, qwen image pro

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用阿里通义万相模型生成和编辑图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用AI快速生成或编辑图片
copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit images with Alibaba Qwen-Image models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate or edit images with AI

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行调用阿里 Qwen-Image-2.0 模型生成或编辑图片，支持文生图、多图编辑和复杂文字渲染。
howto.when: 当用户提到“qwen image”、“qwen-image”、“alibaba image”、“dashscope image”等关键词，或要求生成/编辑图片时触发。

say.text: 用 Qwen-Image 生成一张日落山景图。
用 Qwen-Image-Pro 制作一张促销海报，标题“夏季大促”。
say.note: 使用 Pro 模型处理文字。

say.text: 用 Qwen-Image 编辑图片，把图1的人物穿上图2的衣服。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate or edit images using Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0 models via the command line, supporting text-to-image, multi-image editing, and complex text rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "qwen image", "qwen-image", "alibaba image", "dashscope image", or asks to generate/edit images.

say_en.text: Generate a sunset mountain landscape with Qwen-Image.
Create a promo poster with Qwen-Image-Pro, title "Summer Sale".
Edit images with Qwen-Image: put person from image 1 into dress from image 2.
